column1: # Reference gold set for the catalogue matcher: ingredient names as recipes write them, with the
# catalogue foods they mean. Written for the purpose, never taken from production data.
# Columns: typed name, language it is written in, expected catalogue keys. Several keys separated by
# "|" are equally right; "-" means no food fits and nothing must be linked silently.
# Keys must exist in the shipped catalogue; CatalogueMatcherReferenceSetTest checks that too.
# Deliberately included: plurals, adjectives that do not change the food, state words, compounds,
# typos, English names, and traps where a word of another food is part of the name.
# --- traps: nothing fits, or another food's word is part of the name
